Butler County, Home to over 42,000 Residents.
Butler county offers many beautiful places to explore. A variety of recreational activities are provided by Wappapello Lake, the Mark Twain National Forest, the St. Francis, Black, and Little Black Rivers are also enjoyed by Butler County residents and visitors to the area. Poplar Bluff offers free access to the beautiful Wolf Creek recreation area, with over 20 miles of developed trail open to hikers, runners and cyclists.
In addition to the scenic beauty of the Ozarks, Butler County offers many opportunities for businesses. The area is experiencing growth, and there is demand for new industries. Several large businesses have seen great success in the area in recent years. For more information about economic opportunities, please reach out to one of the local area chambers of commerce.
